onset: 2026-03-17T09:19:00.000Z
The incident began around 09:19 when the downstream supplier_p95_ms jumped dramatically from 208 ms to 7791 ms and supplier_error_rate increased from 0.0006 to 0.001, with inflight_requests also rising. Concurrently, http error_rate increased sharply from 0.0014 to 0.0451 and p95 latency rose from 173.16 ms to 182.54 ms, indicating a downstream service degradation impacting the API latency. The http rps remained relatively stable, indicating the traffic volume was not the cause. The deploy at 09:03 did not cause immediate issues, as metrics were stable until 09:19. This suggests the incident is related to downstream service performance degradation rather than traffic spikes or deployment issues.
